maddeler.e:
استبقين (form X)
# اِسْتَبْقَيْنَ (istabqayna) /is.tab.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اُسْتُبْقِينَ (ustubqīna) /us.tub.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
# اِسْتَبْقِينَ (istabqīna) /is.tab.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْقَى (istabqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
